calculation.speech_attribution: event-date Dáil membership and party history
calculation.raw_counts: distinct policy-classified speeches by party and issue in period; top 7
calculation.share_vs_average: party issue share minus unweighted mean issue share across all displayed period-end groups, including zero shares; positive top 7
calculation.per_td_denominator: active Dáil TDs in party/group at period end
calculation.per_td_vs_average: party issue speeches per period-end TD minus unweighted mean rate across all displayed groups, including zero rates; positive top 7

chart_geometry.short_chart_bar_thickness_policy: 1-3 row charts use a centered virtual 4-row stack

more_per_td.slide_title: Issues Discussed More Than Average per TD

outer_text_metrics.source_text: Issues Discussed More Than Average per TD

glossary_terms: Issues Discussed More Than Average per TD

text_bounds.text: Most Discussed Issues
The issues this party/group talked about most often during the
month, based on the number of classified speeches.
Issues Discussed More Than Average
Issues that made up a larger share of this party/group's classified
speeches than the simple average across parties. Values show
percentage points above average.
Issues Discussed More Than Average per TD
Issues where this party/group recorded more classified speeches per
TD than the simple average across parties. This adjusts the
comparison for party size.
Classified Speeches
Speech segments assigned to an issue category. Counts show how
often an issue was discussed, not the party/group's position on it.
